comments.value:
I very much agree that this should be a mandatory tag for assets, avatars, and worlds in VRChat if they use AI generation.

Heartily agreed.
Absolutely agree. Has to happen NOW.
Big agree, please do not let this turn into a nightmare for avatar and world creators.

The amount of AI content flooding the world/avatar scene is in of itself abhorent. Countless worlds I've seen will use AI to sell a bigger product than what the world is, I often explore backrooms maps. And the amount of AI thumbnail backrooms maps with literally NOTHING in them is obscene, it's meant to get you in the map to just get people in a room effectively, there is no substance, there is no heart. Just garbage.
This is the kind of issue that needs to be dealt with now before it becomes a out of control problem due to how little effort is required to churn out this AI Shite
Not only that, AI thumbnaila are already a problem on the platform

The widespread usage of generative AI will devalue the handmade works of the community and kill interest in creating new content further whenever world creators already feel punished for not curating their creations to be more gamified and optimized purely for engagement.

There's something to be said about this issue being raised and ignored multiple times already, but there needs to be an update to content tags overall given their lack of functionality including new tags for AI usage and some kind of knockback/warning system against users who are found to ignore correctly tagging their content multiple times rather than outright banning users leading to the abusive reports that have already been a problem for a while.

This this this. We need identifiers for this kind of thing. I dont want to experience AI, i dont want it in my content, and i hate finding out half way through something that it is AI. 

Let me at least know what im seeing. I should have the choice to go into a place knowing what was used to create it, and the only reason i see people fighting against such identifiers is because they know that as soon as AI is flagged, they lose views. 

If you know something is bad as a creator, and know people will be against it, then why create it? This holds creators accountable for the material they put out there.
Don't let AI Tech Bros ruin VRC!
We urgently need GenAI content flagging/filtering.

details:
Just today I have seen 3 X/Twitter posts of fully AI generated worlds made using GPT-6 Astra, one of them already published.

https://x.com/yuipxq/status/2097025460295389601

https://x.com/kurotori4423/status/2097011323767034098

https://x.com/pichikyo/status/2096285284178788612

I fear this kind of content will soon flood the platform. VRChat needed to add some kind of AI tag or descriptor a long time ago. This kind of quickly and effortlessly generated content hurts existing creators on this platform.

Please don't let this become another "too little, too late" situation. VRChat needs an identifier for AI generated content added ASAP. Regardless of how end users personally feel about the use of AI, a way to separate and identify AI generated content from user created content is an absolute necessity.
title: Add an AI content identifier for worlds and avatars
